Use lsodar, deSolve method finds roots.  event engine applies SBML rules events: trigger fires changes false true; initialValue says time 0; delay postpones execution, non-persistent event canceled trigger turns false meanwhile; events due time run priority order, random order tied, set seed reproducible run.

title: Read, Write and Derive Equations from SBML Models
text: SBML, Systems Biology Markup Language, models biochemical networks, pharmacokinetics cell signaling shared: hundreds curated BioModels. SBML file describes reactions species compartments, solver wants dX/dt state. translation, amounts concentrations, compartments change size, conversion factors events, hand-written versions go wrong. R packages read SBML either need libSBML system library longer maintained. zusbml reads SBML document one R object, writes back SBML, derives equations solver needs, nothing R installed. Derivation point. sbml_odes() gives states, right-hand sides, assignments events R expressions; sbml_derivs() turns function deSolve, SBML’s event semantics (delays, priorities, persistence) included. Checked SBML Test Suite. 1,384 cases SBML Test Suite 3.5.0 within supported set reproduce reference results case’s tolerances. 308 Level 3 Version 2 cases use algebraic rules, delay, fast reactions SBML packages, refused name rather approximated. Pure R. package zusbml imports zuxml, XML; system library install. Round trips. Reading, writing reading gives identical model, every readable Test Suite case fifty curated BioModels.
